text:
Lina: Dashboard spike: strict-canary fncall rejects showing up under noop_tool with enforcement label lost.

Omar: Example?

Lina: Validator log: validator.failure=missing_enum enforcement=strict-canary; router rewrites to noop_tool for fallback. Raw request had labels {deployment=strict-canary,canary=true} but ingest events lack them.

Priya: That breaks canary health and quota math.

Ravi: Router intentionally creates fresh telemetry envelope during fallback to keep size down. We didn't copy over deployment/canary.

Omar: Proposal: implement preserved_labels header (base64 json) for small set ["deployment","canary","enforcement"]. Router sets it before route mutation. Ingest merges preserved_labels into event.

Priya: Console change: surface original_enforcement in reject drilldown.

Lina: I'll file router PR + unit test asserting preserved_labels present on degen/noop fallback.

ingest-bot: Ingest v2 now supports preserved_labels merge.

Ravi: Add analytics to monitor preserved_labels size and frequency. Backfill join job optional.

Omar: Temporary alert: percent of noop_tool rejects missing preserved_labels > 0.5% per minute -> fire low-sev no-pager.

Lina: Timeline: router + ingest merge in next 48h window; console/backfill next sprint. Ping for reviews.
